headline: Wageni wa biashara wasisubiri vyumba
body: Hakikisha vyumba viko tayari kabla ya mteja kufika. Operra inakuonyesha hali ya usafi wa vyumba vyako papo hapo.
caption:
Dar es Salaam ina kasi yake. Wageni wa makampuni wakifika hoteli yako baada ya safari ndefu, wanataka funguo zao haraka ili wawahi vikao.

Operra inakuonyesha vyumba vilivyosafishwa na kukaguliwa papo hapo kwenye mfumo. Hakuna tena kupigiana simu au kutumiana meseji kati ya mapokezi na housekeeping. Wageni wako wanaingia chumbani bila kusubiri.

Dhibiti kasi ya hoteli yako leo.
imagePrompt: A wide interior shot of a modern hotel lobby during golden hour. Deep perspective with long shadows stretching across the polished floor. Soft, warm golden-hour light streams through large windows on the right, illuminating a minimalist reception desk on the right-of-centre. The left side is a calm, empty concrete wall in deep shadow. Film grain texture, no text, no people, no logos.

headline: Msimu wa wageni usichafue hesabu za maajenti wako
body: Fuatilia malipo na invois zote za makampuni ya utalii bila kupoteza kumbukumbu hata moja wakati wa msimu wa kazi.
caption:
Arusha wakati wa msimu wa watalii, makundi ya wageni yanajaza vyumba haraka. Changamoto kubwa inakuja kwenye kufuatilia invois na malipo ya maajenti wa utalii.

Operra inamaliza fujo hii. Unaweza kufuatilia malipo ya kila ejenti na makundi ya wageni kwa urahisi kwenye mfumo mmoja unaofanya kazi hata mtandao ukiwa chini. Linda mapato yako msimu huu.
imagePrompt: An overhead flat-lay shot looking straight down onto a dark wood table. On the right-of-centre of the table, a cup of chai, a folded guest register paper, a pen, and classic brass room keys are neatly arranged. The left side of the frame is empty, showing only the plain dark wood tabletop with soft shadows. Mid-tone, even soft daylight. No text, no people, no logos.

headline: Track every currency and commission automatically
body: Operra records every room rate change, foreign currency payment, and OTA commission in one secure audit trail.
caption: Running a resort in Zanzibar means dealing with multiple currencies, long-stay bookings, and complex OTA commissions daily. When your front desk manually converts rates or adjusts room charges, mistakes happen. Operra simplifies your audit by tracking every single rate change, payment, and commission in one place. You see exactly who made an update and when, even on low-bandwidth connections.
imagePrompt: Extreme macro shot of crisp white hotel linen, capturing the fine folds and detailed stitching in soft morning light. The composition fills the frame, with high-key, light, and clean tones. The left side is visually calm with smooth, out-of-focus white fabric, while the subtle details of the fabric weave and folds are textured on the right-of-centre. No text, no people, no logos.

headline: Mwanza: Wageni wa mkutano hawacheleweshwi mapokezi
body: Mfumo wetu rahisi unasaidia timu yako ndogo kuratibu vyumba na malipo haraka sana bila makosa ya hesabu.
caption:
Wageni wa mkutano wakishuka kwenye boti au kufika kwa pamoja hotelini kwako Mwanza, presha huwa kubwa mapokezi. Kama una timu ndogo, hapo ndipo makosa ya vyumba na malipo yanapotokea.

Hoteli zinazotumia Operra zinaratibu mapokezi, usafi wa vyumba, na malipo kwenye skrini moja rahisi. Kila mfanyakazi anaona taarifa kwa lugha anayoielewa, hata mtandao ukiwa wa kusuasua.
imagePrompt: A minimal architectural line drawing of a modern lakeside pavilion with thin black strokes on a flat cream-colored field. Abstract geometric lines, subtle grids, and flat planes representing minimalist structures. The left third is completely empty, clean, and calm plain space. The right-of-centre features a delicate layout of fine architectural lines. Pure flat graphic, no photography, no text, no people, no logos.

headline: Punguza msongamano wa wageni wa milimani
body: Wageni wakishuka Kilimanjaro wanahitaji vyumba haraka. Panga vyumba na malipo mapema kwa kushirikiana na waongoza watalii.
caption:
Wageni wakishuka Kilimanjaro hapa Moshi, wanachotaka ni kuoga na kupumzika haraka. Ukisubiri wafike ndipo uanze kupanga vyumba na kuandika majina, mapokezi yatajaa fujo.

Weka utaratibu wa kupata orodha ya wageni na kupanga vyumba siku moja kabla hawajashuka mlimani. Mwongoza wageni akifika nao, anachukua funguo tu. Hii inapunguza foleni na kuacha sifa nzuri kwa wateja wako.
imagePrompt: Zanzibar shoreline, whitewashed wall, palm shadow falling across it, midday sun. Exterior landscape, wide horizon. Bright, sunlit, airy. Left side visually calm with a plain wall, detail on the right-of-centre. No text, no people, no logos.

headline: Corporate guests cannot wait for manual billing
body: Dar es Salaam business hotels face rapid morning check-outs. Split room rates and restaurant extras instantly to keep corporate accounts happy.
caption: Morning rush hour in Dar es Salaam means corporate guests need to check out fast to catch meetings or flights. If your front desk is stuck manually separating room charges from dinner bills, queues build up. Operra simplifies split invoicing. Your team can print clean, accurate corporate invoices in seconds, keeping your business accounts loyal and your lobby clear.
